articles.title: Marconi Perillo fala em desburocratização no setor empresarial | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato conversou com empresários de Goiás. Marconi defendeu medidas para simplificar processos tributários.
articles.summary: Candidato conversou com empresários de Goiás. Marconi defendeu medidas para simplificar processos tributários.
articles.body:
Marconi Perillo ( PSDB ), candidato ao governo de Goiás, defendeu medidas para desburocratizar o setor produtivo, simplificar processos tributários e atrair investimentos. As declarações foram feitas durante sabatina realizada na Associação Comercial, Industrial e de Serviços do Estado de Goiás (Acieg), em Goiânia , nesta quarta-feira (9), em encontro com empresários e lideranças econômicas de Goiás.

O encontro foi realizado na sede da entidade, no Setor Oeste. A sabatina abriu uma série de mesas-redondas que a Acieg promoverá com os candidatos ao Palácio das Esmeraldas.

Durante a conversa, o candidato apresentou propostas voltadas ao incentivo à indústria, ao comércio e ao setor de serviços. Entre os pontos defendidos, Marconi destacou a necessidade de qualificar a mão de obra local por meio da Universidade Estadual de Goiás (UEG).

Além disso, o candidato disse que aplicar tecnologias específicas para cada área produtiva e reduzir os entraves burocráticos e fiscais que travam a abertura e o fechamento de empresas.

Eleições 2026: Marconi Perillo fala em desburocratização no setor empresarial e em atração de investimentos durante sabatina na Acieg — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhanguera

"O objetivo é criar condições para que a gente possa continuar atraindo investimentos industriais e empresariais para manter a nossa economia dinâmica e para gerar mais empregos, desburocratizando a questão da instalação e do fechamento de empresas", destacou o candidato.

Marconi ainda defendeu a criação de polos de desenvolvimento tecnológico distribuídos pelas regiões goianas segundo a vocação econômica de cada localidade, integrando incentivos para o primeiro emprego e para o empreendedorismo jovem.

articles.title: VÍDEO: fogo atinge área de mata perto de rodovia no interior do Amapá  | G1
articles.standfirst: Chamas atingem vegetação há mais de 10 horas. Equipes do Corpo de Bombeiros atuam no local, e a suspeita é de que o incêndio tenha sido provocado.
articles.summary: Chamas atingem vegetação há mais de 10 horas. Equipes do Corpo de Bombeiros atuam no local, e a suspeita é de que o incêndio tenha sido provocado.
articles.body:
Um incêndio atinge uma área de vegetação no quilômetro 21 da BR-156, no interior do Amapá, desde a manhã desta quarta-feira (9). O fogo se espalhou por uma área extensa e os bombeiros trabalham para conter as chamas.

Imagens registradas mostram a intensidade das chamas, que já consumiram boa parte da vegetação. A suspeita é de que o incêndio tenha sido provocado.

De acordo com o Corpo de Bombeiros, em alguns casos pessoas colocam fogo para “limpar” terrenos, prática considerada perigosa porque pode sair do controle.

“Alguém colocou fogo para limpar, outros fazem por maldade e há quem use para capturar animais”, disse o porta-voz dos bombeiros, tenente-coronel Izídio Júnior.

O incêndio acontece perto da rotatória do quilômetro 21, na região próxima a comunidade de Campina Grande, onde há moradores.

A preocupação é que o fogo se espalhe ainda mais e que a fumaça afete moradores da região. Animais que vivem na mata também sofrem com o incêndio.

Imagens dos bombeiros mostram o contraste das chamas durante o dia e à noite. No escuro, a intensidade do fogo era ainda mais visível.

Incêndio no quilometro 21 da BR-156 — Foto: Reprodução

Os bombeiros usam abafadores para tentar controlar o fogo. Com a estiagem, a tendência é que os incêndios aumentem. A vegetação seca eleva o risco.

articles.title: Justiça determina retirada de propaganda eleitoral irregular  | G1
articles.standfirst: Bandeiras e outros materiais instalados em pontos de circulação podem prejudicar a visibilidade de motoristas e representar risco de acidentes.
articles.summary: Justiça determina retirada de propaganda eleitoral irregular de ruas e avenidas de Paragominas
articles.body:
A Justiça Eleitoral determinou a retirada de propagandas eleitorais instaladas irregularmente em ruas e avenidas de Paragominas, no sudeste do Pará. A medida busca impedir que bandeiras e outros materiais de campanha prejudiquem a circulação e a visibilidade de motoristas em pontos de maior movimentação da cidade.

A preocupação é principalmente com materiais colocados em locais onde a obstrução da visão pode comprometer a segurança no trânsito. A propaganda eleitoral não pode ser distribuída de forma que dificulte o deslocamento de pessoas e veículos.

As regras eleitorais também estabelecem restrições para o uso de espaços públicos na divulgação de candidaturas. Entre elas está a proibição de propaganda em árvores e jardins localizados em áreas públicas.

Os responsáveis pelas campanhas devem retirar os materiais considerados irregulares. A Justiça Eleitoral também pode fiscalizar o cumprimento das regras e adotar as medidas previstas na legislação eleitoral em caso de irregularidades.

Eleitores também podem denunciar propaganda eleitoral irregular por meio do aplicativo Pardal, da Justiça Eleitoral. A ferramenta permite encaminhar informações sobre possíveis infrações para análise.

articles.title: William Siri propõe nova estratégia contra o crime organizado no RJ | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato do PSOL ao governo do RJ fez campanha em Duque de Caxias, na Baixada Fluminense, nesta quarta-feira (9).
articles.summary: William Siri, candidato do PSOL ao governo do RJ, defende inteligência contra o crime organizado e valorização de policiais em campanha na Baixada Fluminense.
articles.body:
O candidato do PSOL ao governo do RJ, William Siri , fez campanha em Duque de Caxias, na Baixada Fluminense, nesta quarta-feira (9).

Siri disse que, se for eleito, pretende criar uma nova estratégia de enfrentamento ao crime organizado, com planejamento, inteligência e integração entre as forças de segurança.

Entre as medidas estão a retomada de territórios dominados por facções e milícias, com presença permanente do estado, o fim de indicações políticas para o comando das forças de segurança e o combate à estrutura financeira das organizações criminosas.

William Siri também afirmou que pretende valorizar os agentes de segurança com novos concursos e recomposição dos efetivos.

William Siri pretende criar nova estratégia de enfrentamento ao crime organizado — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

"Nós vamos retomar todo o território do Rio de Janeiro, mas não olhando a favela como território inimigo. Queremos o estado pleno, com educação, cultura, saneamento básico. Vamos fazer novos concursos e valorizar o policial militar e o policial civil", comentou Siri.

articles.title: Taty Cristina de Jesus defende valorização de professores em SE | G1
articles.standfirst: A candidata fez gravação de conteúdo audiovisual, realizou ação de corpo a corpo na região do Centro da capital e participou de uma reunião com empreendedoras.
articles.summary: A candidata ao governo de Sergipe cumpriu agenda no Centro da capital, reuniu-se com empreendedoras e destacou a importância de preparar jovens para o mercado de trabalho.
articles.body:
Nesta quarta-feira (9), o jornalismo do g1 e da TV Sergipe deu continuidade ao acompanhamento das agendas dos candidatos ao governo de Sergipe. A ordem de veiculação das matérias foi definida em reunião com representantes de todos os partidos e coligações.

A candidata fez gravação de conteúdo audiovisual, realizou ação com eleitores na região do Centro da capital e participou de uma reunião com empreendedoras. Ela falou à equipe da TV Sergipe sobre educação.

Taty Cristina de Jesus disputa do governo de Sergipe pelo DC — Foto: TV Sergipe

"A gente sabe que não existe uma educação com qualidade, precisamos entender a valorização dos professores. Valorizar essa classe. Sentar e ouvir é o primeiro passo. A educação hoje precisa de jovens preparados para o primeiro emprego e para a vida", disse.

articles.title: Rejane de Oliveira defende  projeto pedagógico com comunidade escolar | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidata ao governo do Rio Grande do Sul pelo PSTU cumpriu compromissos de campanha em Porto Alegre.
articles.summary: Candidata ao governo do Rio Grande do Sul pelo PSTU cumpriu compromissos de campanha em Porto Alegre.
articles.body:
Candidata ao governo do Rio Grande do Sul pelo PSTU, Rejane de Oliveira cumpriu compromissos de campanha nesta quarta-feira (2). Ele esteve na região central de Porto Alegre .

A professora esteve em frente ao colégio estadual Júlio de Castilhos. Ela distribuiu material de campanha e conversou com estudantes sobre suas propostas. Rejane defende a valorização salarial dos profissionais da educação e o fim das Parcerias Público-Privadas (PPPs) em escolas estaduais.

Até o dia 2 de outubro, os candidatos ao governo do Rio Grande do Sul vão responder perguntas feitas diretamente por eleitores entrevistados pela RBS TV. Serão seis temas, um a cada semana: segurança, saúde, educação, infraestrutura, economia e prevenção a desastres climáticos . Ao todo, 86 eleitores terão suas dúvidas respondidas .

Os candidatos terão 30 segundos para apresentar suas respostas. Dos sete candidatos, três responderão em cada dia . A ordem de aparição leva em conta a mais recente pesquisa eleitoral contratada pelo Grupo RBS , divulgada nesta segunda-feira (24).

Sobre educação , o candidato escolheu a pergunta da eleitora Carolina, de Santa Cruz do Sul, na região do Vale do Rio Pardo. "Gostaria de saber o que tu faria para reduzir o número de analfabetos no Rio Grande do Sul" , questiona.

"É preciso investimento na educação, política de acesso, mas também de permanência dentro das escolas. Isso significa construir um projeto pedagógico com a comunidade escolar, fazer com que a escola pública seja um espaço social, de inclusão e valorização dos trabalhadores em educação. Queremos o piso nacional, carreira, fim do desconto dos aposentados, a efetivação dos contratados e fim das PPPs", afirmou Rejane.

articles.title: Trad leva propostas para saúde à Santa Casa e Riedel participa de sabatina | G1
articles.standfirst: Fábio Trad visitou a Santa Casa de Campo Grande e apresentou propostas para a saúde; Eduardo Riedel participou de sabatina.
articles.summary: Fábio Trad visitou a Santa Casa de Campo Grande e apresentou propostas para a saúde; Eduardo Riedel participou de sabatina.
articles.body:
Fábio Trad durante agenda na Santa Casa de Campo Grande — Foto: TV Morena.

A agenda dos candidatos ao governo de Mato Grosso do Sul, Fábio Trad (PT) e Eduardo Riedel (PP), foi marcada por entrevistas e visitas a hospitais de Campo Grande .

🔎 Às terças e quintas-feiras, a TV Morena mostra o dia de campanha dos candidatos ao governo que tiveram entre 1% e 4% na pesquisa Quaest/TV Morena.

Em Campo Grande, o candidato ao governo pelo PT cumpriu agenda na Santa Casa de Campo Grande, onde se reuniu com a direção do hospital e apresentou propostas para a área.

O candidato do PT foi à Santa Casa para conhecer os números e entender as dificuldades financeiras enfrentadas pela instituição, que recebe pacientes de várias regiões do estado.

Depois da reunião, Fábio Trad defendeu a ampliação do atendimento especializado no interior. Entre as propostas apresentadas estão a criação de quatro centros oncológicos regionais, mais investimentos em telemedicina e incentivos para profissionais da saúde que atuem fora da capital.

O candidato também propôs uma fila digital do SUS, para que cada paciente possa acompanhar a posição e o tempo estimado de espera por atendimento.

“Eu fiquei dez minutos aqui, vi várias ambulâncias de muitos municípios do estado chegando. A pergunta é: por que eles não são tratados em cidades mais próximas de onde moram? Prioridade absoluta: saúde. Sem saúde, o cidadão não atravessa uma rua e, com saúde, tem boa educação e pode ter segurança.”

Já o candidato do PP ao governo, Eduardo Riedel, participou de uma sabatina, pela manhã, em uma rede de rádio e televisão da capital.

Os demais candidatos não enviaram suas agendas dentro do prazo estipulado.

articles.title: VÍDEO: casa de Zezé Di Camargo em MT terá banheiro spa, cinema e bar   | G1
articles.standfirst: Projeto começou a ser pensado em 2023 e mistura referências do neoclássico europeu com elementos inspirados no clima e na identidade de Chapada dos Guimarães (MT).
articles.summary: Zezé Di Camargo constrói casa em Chapada dos Guimarães com projeto que une o estilo neoclássico europeu à identidade regional de Mato Grosso.
articles.body:
Imagens divulgadas pela arquiteta Ilana Santiago mostram os detalhes da mansão do cantor Zezé Di Camargo e a esposa, a influenciadora digital Graciele Lacerda. Com 607 m² construídos, métrica maior do que uma quadra oficial de basquete, o imóvel terá quatro suítes amplas, espaço gourmet integrado à cozinha, cinema em casa e cozinha de apoio.

O projeto tem como proposta uma casa de campo com colunas imponentes, acabamentos em pedra e grandes janelas. Ao g1 , Ilana disse que Zezé e Graciele compartilharam referências e características que gostariam de ver na residência, mas deixaram o desenvolvimento arquitetônico a cargo do escritório.

“Eles contaram para a gente a história do que é importante para eles e deram total liberdade para a gente trabalhar dentro do conceito do projeto deles”, afirmou.

Zezé Di Camargo e Graciele Lacerda terão casa de campo em Chapada dos Guimarães — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram

A fachada terá acabamento em tijolos de travertino e referências do estilo neoclássico europeu. A proposta também busca estabelecer uma relação com o entorno de Chapada dos Guimarães , levando em consideração o clima da região e a identidade da família. Tons de azul também aparecem na composição visual da residência.

A área de convivência é um dos destaques da residência. O imóvel terá quatro suítes amplas, living com bar, espaço gourmet integrado à cozinha, home cinema e cozinha de apoio. O living é um espaço destinado para convivência e contará com integração entre os ambientes. A residência também contará com um bar privado e uma área gourmet planejada para encontros e festas.

Segundo Ilana, alguns elementos foram desenvolvidos especialmente para o projeto, incluindo revestimentos exclusivos e ambientes pensados para proporcionar conforto no dia a dia.

“Nós trabalhamos alguns revestimentos exclusivos, com pedras, alguns detalhes que são bem especiais para projetos, como um banheiro com jardim interno, que seja bem gostoso para eles no dia a dia, e um gourmet acompanhado de um bar, que seja um espaço onde ele possa reunir bem os amigos”, detalhou.

No segundo andar, o projeto prevê uma suíte com closet e banheiro inspirado no conceito de spa. Outro banheiro terá paisagismo integrado, com um jardim interno incorporado ao ambiente. Para Ilana, a ideia foi equilibrar sofisticação e aconchego, sem deixar de lado a finalidade principal da residência: ser um espaço de descanso e convivência.

“A estrutura da casa tem um projeto incrível, de forma que seja bem gostoso, aconchegante, porém sofisticado ao mesmo tempo. É um projeto que une o prazer deles de estarem entre amigos em alguns dias que passam no Mato Grosso, aliado ao bem-estar, ao espaço muito confortável e aconchegante para eles poderem desfrutar e descansar também”, concluiu.

articles.title: Daniel Vilela promete investimentos no agronegócio e infraestrutura | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato do MDB caminhou pelo comércio de Jataí nesta quarta-feira (9). Vilela destacou propostas voltadas à infraestrutura para fortalecer o escoamento do agronegócio goiano.
articles.summary: Daniel Vilela destaca obras de infraestrutura rodoviária em Jataí para fortalecer o agronegócio em Goiás e garantir o escoamento da produção estadual.
articles.body:
O candidato ao governo de Goiás, Daniel Vilela ( MDB ), fez uma caminhada na principal avenida comercial de Jataí , sua cidade natal, no sudoeste do estado, nesta quarta-feira (9). Daniel foi acompanhado de parceiros políticos, conversou com comerciantes e apresentou propostas para os eleitores. O candidato aproveitou a oportunidade para destacar propostas de campanha para o setor do agronegócio.

Na visita ao sudoeste goiano, que é uma das regiões que mais produzem grãos no estado, Daniel Vilela disse que uma das formas de fortalecer a agricultura é facilitar o escoamento dos grãos. Segundo ele, está entre as prioridades como candidato o investimento na infraestrutura das rodovias.

"São mais de 80 obras rodoviárias hoje em todas as regiões do estado, exatamente no sentido de potencializar esse setor que é o mais importante da nossa economia, que é o agronegócio", disse Daniel.

Ainda de acordo com o candidato, os investimentos que já foram executados vão ajudar Goiás a dar um grande salto na produção e contribuir para que o estado seja a referência do agronegócio brasileiro. Daniel Vilela também cumprimentou e tirou fotos com eleitores, entrou em lojas e conversou com comerciantes.

articles.title: Quatro jiboias são resgatadas no Complexo Penal da Mata Escura  | G1
articles.standfirst: Animais foram encontrados no perímetro da unidade prisional e encaminhados ao Centro de Triagem de Animais Silvestres (Cetas) do Inema.
articles.summary: Animais foram encontrados no perímetro da unidade prisional e encaminhados ao Centro de Triagem de Animais Silvestres (Cetas) do Inema.
articles.body:
Quatro jiboias foram resgatadas no Complexo Penal da Mata Escura, em Salvador , nesta quarta-feira (9). A ação foi realizada pelo Grupamento Especial de Proteção Ambiental (GEPA) da Guarda Civil Municipal.

O resgate contou com o apoio do Grupamento Especial de Operações Penitenciárias (GEOP), formado por policiais penais, que atuaram na segurança da área e no atendimento da ocorrência.

Após o manejo, as serpentes foram colocadas em caixas de transporte e encaminhadas para o Centro de Triagem de Animais Silvestres (Cetas) do Instituto do Meio Ambiente e Recursos Hídricos (Inema).

No local, os animais passarão por avaliações veterinária e biológica antes de serem devolvidos à natureza, em uma área de preservação.

Segundo as informações divulgadas pelos órgãos envolvidos na ação, o aparecimento das jiboias está relacionado à proximidade do complexo penal com áreas de mata. O resgate técnico é necessário para evitar acidentes e garantir o manejo adequado dos animais.

articles.title: Deck é destruído por incêndio na Gameleira, em Rio Branco | G1
articles.standfirst: Denuncia relata que estrutura está danificada desde o dia 24 de agosto. Suspeita é de que fogo tenha sido intencional.
articles.summary: Denuncia relata que estrutura está danificada desde o dia 24 de agosto. Suspeita é de que fogo tenha sido intencional. Seop informou que a área está sob responsabilidade da União.
articles.body:
O deck de madeira no Calçadão da Gameleira, no Centro de Rio Branco , ficou parcialmente destruído após um incêndio e ficou sem condições de ser utilizado. A estrutura consumida pelas chamas deixou um grande buraco no local, que está sem sinalização para alertar quem passa pela área.

A situação foi denunciada à Rede Amazônica Acre por telespectadores, que informaram que o deck está danificado desde o dia 24 de agosto. Conforme apurado pela reportagem, o incêndio teria sido intencional.

O trecho destruído pelas chamas integra uma série de decks alternados pela calçada de concreto e fica localizado após os quiosques e os pontos de táxi, sentido à rotatória que leva às ruas Dezesseis de Outubro e Nossa Senhora da Conceiç~/ao

Imagens feitas no local histórico mostram as tábuas queimadas, além de madeiras soltas e parte do piso completamente destruído, com apenas algumas pernamancas, peças mais grossas usadas na sustentação da estrutura. Até a tarde dessa terça-feira (8), o local não estava sinalizado.

Em nota ao g1 , a Secretaria de Estado de Obras Públicas (Seop) informou que, em relação à deterioração da estrutura, a área permanece sob responsabilidade da União. Segundo a pasta, qualquer intervenção no local depende de autorização do órgão federal responsável. (Veja mais abaixo)

Deck de madeira da Gameleira, em Rio Branco, ficou parcialmente destruído após um incêndio — Foto: Rede Amazônica Acre

A reportagem também entrou em contato com o Corpo de Bombeiros e com a Advocacia Geral da União (AGU), e, até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia obtido resposta.

Além do risco de acidentes, a área danificada fica em um ponto de circulação de moradores e turistas que frequentam o calçadão, um dos principais pontos turísticos da capital, de onde é possível observar o Rio Acre.

Imagens de 2024 mostram como era o trecho consumido pelo incêndio — Foto: Reprodução/Google Street View

A Gameleira fica no Segundo Distrito e reúne prédios históricos, a árvore centenária plantada por Neutel Maia, fundador do seringal que deu origem à cidade, e o mastro da bandeira acreana.

O espaço passou por uma revitalização em 2021 , após apresentar problemas estruturais. Ainda naquele ano, os moradores se juntaram para denunciar a situação de abandono e deterioração da estrutura histórica.

Ao final, daquele ano, a região passou por uma obra de revitalização orçada em R$ 400 mil. Conforme o então secretário de Infraestrutura e Desenvolvimento do Acre (Seinfra), Ítalo Medeiros, só na parte do deck, foram 15 dias 'fazendo a substituição das peças por um novo madeirame'.

Os pontos tradicionais entre o 1º e 2º Distrito de Rio Branco, às margens do Rio Acre, têm sofrido com problemas estruturais nos últimos anos.

No dia 12 de julho de 2024, cerca de 270 metros do Calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho foi interditado por conta dos riscos à população. À época, a Passarela Joaquim Macedo, também na mesma região, foi interditada pelo mesmo motivo. Os problemas são atribuídos às enchentes.

O local voltou a passar por obras no dia 15 de abril após um período sem obras. No ano passado, o Ministério Público do Acre (MP-AC) chegou a instaurar um procedimento preparatório para apurar a erosão.

Ainda em 2025, a Defesa Civil Estadual também emitiu um alerta para que os comerciantes deixassem o Calçadão, e afirmou que o solo do local cedia cerca de 1 centímetro a cada dois dias. Conforme o parecer técnico à época, o monitoramento indicava progressão do problema na região.

A respeito da atual situação de deterioração do deck do Calçadão da Gameleira, o Estado informa que a área permanece sob responsabilidade da União, conforme manifestação da Superintendência do Patrimônio da União (SPU).

Em reunião realizada em 27 de janeiro de 2026, a SPU informou que qualquer intervenção no local depende de autorização do órgão federal enquanto não for formalizada a cessão de uso da área.

Diante disso, seguindo a orientação da Procuradoria-Geral do Estado, a Secretaria de Estado de Obras Públicas (Seop) não pode realizar obras ou serviços de manutenção no local sem a devida autorização da União.

A Seop ressalta, contudo, que permanece à disposição para colaborar e adotar as providências necessárias, caso seja formalmente autorizada ou provocada pelo órgão federal responsável pela área, dentro de suas atribuições.

Assim, enquanto não houver a formalização e homologação do instrumento de cessão de uso, as intervenções e manutenções de infraestrutura na área da Gameleira dependem da anuência da União, por meio da Superintendência do Patrimônio da União (SPU).

articles.title: Operação Cavalo de Troia: Bauru exonera secretários investigados | G1
articles.standfirst: Medida ocorre após ação do Gaeco prender sete pessoas e apreender R$ 240 mil na casa de ex-secretário. Na Câmara, vereadores articulam criação de Comissão Especial de Inquérito (CEI).
articles.summary: A Prefeitura de Bauru exonerou quatro investigados na Operação Cavalo de Troia, do Gaeco, após prisões de secretários por suspeita de fraude em licitação bilionária.
articles.body:
A Prefeitura de Bauru anunciou a exoneração de quatro investigados na operação "Cavalo de Tróia ", deflagrada nesta quarta-feira (9) pelo Grupo de Atuação Especial de Combate ao Crime Organizado (Gaeco) do Ministério Público.

A ação apura suspeitas de fraude licitatória na concessão do sistema de gestão integrada dos resíduos sólidos urbanos do município.

Operação do Gaeco, com a apoio da PM, cumpriu diligências em secretarias municipais em Bauru — Foto: Luís Negrelli/ TV TEM

Durante a operação, equipes do Gaeco cumpriram mandados de busca e apreensão em secretarias municipais. Ao todo, sete pessoas foram presas, entre elas dois secretários municipais e uma secretária-adjunta.

Em nota oficial, a administração municipal confirmou a exoneração dos seguintes servidores públicos

Vitor João de Freitas Costa , titular da Secretaria de Negócios Jurídicos

Cilene Chabuh Bordezan , titular da Secretaria de Meio Ambiente e Bem-Estar Animal

Sara Moura de Jesus , secretária-adjunta de Meio Ambiente e Bem-Estar Animal

Roldão Neto , coordenador de Políticas Públicas para o Meio Ambiente

Ainda no comunicado, o Poder Executivo informou que as novas nomeações serão divulgadas em breve e assegurou a continuidade dos serviços prestados à população e o funcionamento regular da administração municipal. (Confira a íntegra do comunicado ao final da reportagem).

Segundo apuração da TV TEM , durante as diligências do Gaeco foram apreendidos R$ 240 mil em espécie na casa do ex-secretário de Negócios Jurídicos, Vitor João de Freitas Costa.

Em paralelo, a Câmara Municipal de Bauru instaurou um pedido de Comissão Especial de Inquérito (CEI) para apurar os contratos, licitações e pagamentos vinculados à Secretaria do Meio Ambiente.

O requerimento atingiu dez assinaturas, superando o mínimo de sete exigido pelo regimento interno, o que garante a abertura automática da CEI para investigar a atuação de agentes públicos e empresas na próxima sessão legislativa, marcada para segunda-feira (14).

Denominada Cavalo de Troia, a ação tem como objetivo apurar a suspeita de fraude licitatória na concessão do sistema de gestão integrada dos resíduos sólidos urbanos do município de Bauru.

Em conjunto, houve o cumprimento de diligências também na Operação Mobius, visando a esclarecer irregularidades no contrato de coleta seletiva.

Equipes do Gaeco com apoio da Polícia Militar realizaram a operação em secretarias municipais de Bauru — Foto: Luís Negrelli/ TV TEM

Durante a manhã, foi registrada grande movimentação na sede da Secretaria Municipal de Meio Ambiente, que fica na Rua Wenceslau Braz. No prédio, também funcionam outras secretarias.

Os funcionários e servidores foram dispensados durante esta manhã. Sete pessoas foram presas na ação, sendo cinco em Bauru e duas em São Paulo.

Segundo apurado pela reportagem da TV TEM , são elas:

Vitor João de Freitas Costa, secretário de Negócios Jurídicos

Cilene Bordezan, secretária de Meio Ambiente

Sara Moura de Jesus, secretária adjunta de Meio Ambiente

Gisele Moretti, presidente da Associação dos Catadores de Reciclagem de Bauru (Ascam)

Valdomiro Pereira da Silva Filho, empresário

Hamilton Libório Agle, proprietário da Estre Ambiental

Talita de Andrade Soares Chieregatti, funcionária da Estre Ambiental

Também houve o afastamento pela Justiça de Roldão Neto, que era coordenador de Políticas Públicas para o Meio Ambiente. A reportagem do g1 e da TV TEM tenta o contato com a defesa dos envolvidos.

O nome da operação, Cavalo de Troia , faz referência à principal estratégia identificada durante as investigações que foi a atuação na administração municipal de uma secretária que mantinha vínculos profissionais e econômicos com a empresa beneficiada no processo.

Secretaria do Meio Ambiente foi um dos alvos da operação do Gaeco em Bauru — Foto: Luís Negrelli/ TV TEM

De acordo com o Gaeco, a partir dessa posição estratégica, interesses privados teriam passado a influenciar internamente a formatação e a condução do procedimento, permitindo que decisões formalmente públicas fossem discutidas e preparadas em articulação com representantes empresariais.

A investigação encontrou também, na estrutura da secretaria, outra profissional anteriormente vinculada à empresa alvo dos trabalhos desta quarta.

Segundo o apurado, a contratação tem previsão de durar 30 anos, com valor global estimado em R$ 5.259.651.116,06, em números de fevereiro atualizados de 2026. O valor seria a maior contratação pública já projetada na história de Bauru.

A investigação indica que a fraude não se limitava à inclusão de uma cláusula restritiva no edital. O esquema teria sido construído por camadas, desde a concepção da concessão e a elaboração dos estudos técnicos até a definição das exigências de habilitação e pontuação, passando pela contratação de consultorias, a preparação de documentos oficiais e a reação diante de impugnações e potenciais concorrentes. A finalidade era assegurar vantagem indevida à empresa investigada.

As apurações apontam, ainda, a existência de um núcleo formado por agentes públicos, dirigentes e funcionários de empresa privada, consultores e intermediários, com divisão de funções e atuação coordenada.

Foram identificados indícios de pagamentos e vantagens, circulação reservada de documentos, interferência na elaboração de manifestações administrativas e estratégias destinadas a reduzir a competição e preservar o direcionamento do processo de licitação.

Ficou igualmente demonstrada uma tentativa de expansão do esquema para a cooptação de agentes públicos e a neutralização de mecanismos de controle.

Os investigados chegaram a levantar informações pessoais de um conselheiro do Tribunal de Contas do Estado de São Paulo, supostamente relacionado à relatoria de procedimento naquele órgão. Comunicações interceptadas revelaram planos de aproximação e infiltração de pessoas em instituições públicas, com o objetivo de obter informações privilegiadas e viabilizar a oferta de vantagens indevidas.

Essas investidas integram, segundo a investigação, uma arquitetura mais ampla de aproximação, influência e possível corrupção de diversos agentes públicos, inclusive em projetos de outros municípios, também com valores bilionários.

A operação tem o objetivo de apurar os crimes de fraude ao caráter competitivo da licitação, corrupção ativa e passiva, advocacia administrativa, falsidade ideológica e associação criminosa.

A Prefeitura de Bauru informa que respeita integralmente a atuação do Ministério Público do Estado de São Paulo e as investigações conduzidas pelo Grupo de Atuação Especial de Combate ao Crime Organizado (GAECO), permanecendo à disposição das autoridades para colaborar com o fornecimento de documentos, informações e todos os esclarecimentos necessários.

A Administração Municipal esclarece, ainda, que, conforme os elementos conhecidos e as informações tornadas públicas até o momento, não há qualquer apontamento de participação ou envolvimento da Chefe do Poder Executivo Municipal.

Diante da gravidade das informações tornadas públicas e das medidas judiciais em curso, foram exonerados de seus cargos a secretária municipal de Meio Ambiente e Bem-Estar Animal, Cilene Chabuh Bordezan; o secretário de Negócios Jurídicos, Vitor João de Freitas Costa; e a secretária-adjunta de Meio Ambiente e Bem-Estar Animal, Sara Moura de Jesus. O coordenador de Políticas Públicas para o Meio Ambiente, Roldão Neto, também foi exonerado do cargo de coordenação.

As novas nomeações serão divulgadas oportunamente, assegurando a continuidade dos serviços públicos e o regular funcionamento da Administração Municipal.

A Prefeitura informa também que todos os contratos, procedimentos e vínculos mencionados nas investigações estão sendo submetidos às providências administrativas cabíveis, com a abertura de procedimentos de apuração rigorosa, observadas a natureza jurídica de cada instrumento e a legislação aplicável.

O Município seguirá colaborando integralmente com as investigações e adotando todas as medidas administrativas e legais necessárias para preservar o interesse público, a integridade da gestão e a confiança da população.

articles.title: £8.28 million Grade II-listed Cotswolds mansion devastated by electrical fire months after private buyer purchased 17th-century Barton House; owners say they are 'in so much shock'
articles.summary: UK News: The owners of a historic Grade II-listed Cotswolds mansion valued at more than £8 million have been left “devastated” after an electrical fire tore th.
articles.body: The owners of a historic Grade II-listed Cotswolds mansion valued at more than £8 million have been left “devastated” after an electrical fire tore through the property, destroying much of its roof and causing extensive damage. Barton House, a 17th-century manor near Guiting Power, was sold to a private buyer for £8.28 million in January 2025.The devastating blaze broke out at Barton House on Saturday morning, September 5, with firefighters from across Gloucestershire called to tackle the rapidly spreading fire.Gloucestershire Fire and Rescue Service said it received a call about the domestic fire in Guiting Power at 11.52am. Eight fire engines were sent to the scene, with crews using three jets, two hose reels and 24 breathing apparatus to battle the flames.Firefighters remained at the property for almost 12 hours, with the stop message eventually received at 11.30pm.Images taken in the aftermath show the scale of the destruction, with large sections of the roof completely destroyed. The full extent of the damage to the interior is yet to be established.Owners 'devastated' by mansion fireThe owners, who have asked not to be named, said they were in shock following the blaze and revealed that the fire was caused by an electrical fault in a light fitting on the first floor.Speaking to the Oxford Mail, they said, “We are in so much shock, and it is devastating.”The owners also praised the local community for rallying around them following the fire. Around 30 residents from nearby Guiting Power helped with the clean-up and salvage operation on Sunday, while hundreds of messages of support were sent by local residents.The owners said they were “extremely grateful” to everyone in the surrounding community.Much of historic property damagedBarton House dates back to the 17th century and was restored during the early 20th century. The historic manor was reportedly home to the Hambro family for decades before being sold to its current owners last year.The main house is Grade II listed and sits within extensive grounds in the Cotswold National Landscape.One local resident who entered the property after the fire to help with the recovery effort described the extent of the destruction as heartbreaking.Neil Chapman said volunteers had gone to the house to try to save whatever remained, but there was little that could be salvaged.“A lot of the house is gone, and the owners have lost a lot of personal belongings,” he said.He added that the top floor had been destroyed and that the property would require extensive work to restore it to its former condition.“It is going to need a lot of work to get it back to what it was and back to its former glory,” Chapman said.Cotswolds mansion had recently been renovatedThe fire is particularly devastating because the historic home had recently undergone renovation.According to local residents, the property still contained a number of historic features and items despite the refurbishment.Chapman said there were “a lot of old historic items” still inside the house and described the aftermath as “very sad to see”.The scale of the damage means the future of the Grade II-listed building could now depend on the extent to which its historic structure and surviving interiors can be restored.Barton House features pool, tennis court and extensive groundsBarton House is set across extensive grounds and includes a number of luxury amenities in addition to the main residence.The property features a pool house and associated swimming pool, as well as a tennis court. Its location within the Cotswold National Landscape adds to its appeal as one of the area's notable historic properties.The mansion's £8.28 million sale price in January 2025 reflected both its architectural heritage and its substantial grounds.The fire has now left the owners facing a major recovery and restoration operation, while the local community continues to assist with the clean-up.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Trump says Iran war ‘will end immediately’ after US midterm elections
articles.summary: The president added the US is not looking to restart negotiations with Iran after the failure of previous ceasefires.
articles.body:
United States President Donald Trump has offered his latest prediction for concluding the war in Iran, indicating that an end date could come after the upcoming US midterm elections.

“This war will end immediately after our election,” Trump told reporters on Wednesday before boarding Air Force One for a trip to Dallas, Texas.

Trump claimed the Iranian government was stalling an end to the war in order to secure a more favourable political environment in the US.

The Democratic Party is angling to take control of one or both chambers of Congress in the November 3 midterms. Currently, Trump’s Republican Party maintains slim majorities in both.

“They’re desperate to try and affect the election so that we can get a nice, weak group of people in there,” Trump said of Iran’s strategy for the legislative elections.

He suggested that Iran is counting on Democrats to “leave them alone and let them have their nuclear weapon”.

“All they want is a nuclear weapon, and if they had a nuclear weapon, the whole world is in deep trouble,” Trump said of Iran.

When the war against Iran began on February 28, the country’s nuclear programme was a key justification that the US and Israel cited for launching hostilities. Trump and his officials claimed that Iran posed an “imminent” threat to the US and its allies.

Iran, however, has long denied seeking a nuclear weapon, instead arguing its uranium enrichment is for civilian power purposes only.

US intelligence reports have also cast doubt on whether Iran was building a nuclear weapon, though concerns have been raised over its levels of enrichment.

Negotiations about Iran’s nuclear energy programme were ongoing at the time of the war’s launch, and the issue has repeatedly cropped up in ceasefire negotiations in the six months since.

Trump had previously withdrawn from a 2015 nuclear deal, known as the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), that would have restricted the amount of uranium Iran was allowed to enrich.

When asked on Wednesday whether the US would restart talks with Iranians on a nuclear agreement, the president suggested his ambitions were larger.

“I’m doing much more than a nuclear deal. There’s a lot more than nuclear,” Trump said.

But he also indicated that negotiations with Iran were not a top priority for the US government.

“We’re not looking for it, to be honest,” Trump said. “Originally, I wanted to make a deal. We’re so far down the line. They have very little country left right now.”

Trump’s comments follow remarks from US Energy Secretary Chris Wright, who told ABC News on Sunday “there may not” be a nuclear deal.

Wright suggested instead that the US may continue to launch strikes to weaken Iran’s nuclear infrastructure.

The US already carried out targeted strikes on three Iranian nuclear facilities during the 12-day war between Iran and Israel in June 2025. Trump at the time said those strikes “obliterated” Iran’s nuclear programme.

Negotiations with Iran have floundered in recent months, and the Trump administration has continued to downplay the conflict ahead of the midterm elections.

The war is widely unpopular in the US. A poll last month found that only 31 percent of Americans support the conflict, down from 37 percent in March.

On Wednesday, oil prices rose above $100 a barrel amid renewed US-Iran hostilities, threatening to further increase costs for consumers around the world.

The US military said it struck five Iranian tankers on Tuesday in response to attempted missile attacks on a US Navy warship.

On Wednesday, Trump said more US strikes would follow: “You’re going to see a lot more.”

articles.title: Russian drone alert delayed Zelensky’s departure for Norway, Moldova says
articles.summary: The departure from Moldova of a plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to Norway was delayed when authorities closed the country’s airspace over a drone alert, a Moldovan government spokesperson said on Wednesday.
articles.body: The departure from Moldova of a plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to Norway was delayed when authorities closed the country’s airspace over a drone alert, a Moldovan government spokesperson said on Wednesday. The president’s aircraft was cleared for take-off on Tuesday once it had been established that a Russian drone had come down on Moldovan territory, the spokesperson said in a written statement to Reuters. Moldovan authorities confirmed the drone exploded 160 kilometers (100 miles) from Chișinău International Airport, the Associated Press reported. The airspace restrictions were lifted and Zelensky’s plane took off later than scheduled. Three departures and four arrivals were delayed while Moldovan airspace was closed. Two Russian drones entered Moldovan airspace, officials said on Tuesday. One landed in a field north of the capital, triggering a fire, while the second carried on into Romanian airspace. Moldovan President Maia Sandu denounced the drone intrusions as a “serious threat to people’s lives” and condemned a Russian drone attack on a border crossing with Ukraine that killed two people. Moldova’s ambassador to the US told CNN’s Jim Sciutto the incident was likely “not an accident.” “Most likely this is not an accident because we do not believe in jet propelled drones just flying into Moldova’s territory for surveillance purposes while [the] Ukrainian president’s airplane is on the ground at the airport,” Vladislav Kulminski told CNN. Asked whether Moldovan authorities believe the drone was targeting the Ukrainian president, he said an investigation was ongoing and it was “too early to say.” However, he added that it is well known that Zelensky uses Moldovan airspace for his foreign visits and “this is probably not the first time that something like this happened.” The Kremlin has not commented. Zelensky was traveling to Oslo for the funeral of the king of Norway at the time. Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre told public broadcaster NRK on Wednesday that Zelensky’s plane had nearly been struck by a drone. “His plane was almost hit by a drone as it was about to take off from Moldova. That is the reality he is facing,” said Støre, who did not say what his source was for the information or how close the drone came. Zelensky attended the funeral of King Harald V of Norway on Wednesday, marching behind his coffin along with other heads of state in central Oslo. He left Norway soon after the funeral was over. The Ukrainian president and his wife First Lady Olena Zelenska are due to arrive in Canada on Wednesday where they will visit Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney until September 11, according to a statement from the Canadian leader.

articles.title: A New Yorker cleaned the same Washington Heights block every day for 100 days and spent $2,000 on it; then his neighbours joined in
articles.summary: US News: What began with a $40 cleaning kit and one littered New York City block eventually turned into a neighbourhood effort to clean, garden and reclaim pub.
articles.body: What began with a $40 cleaning kit and one littered New York City block eventually turned into a neighbourhood effort to clean, garden and reclaim public space. David Clarke, a 24-year-old New Yorker behind the grassroots project Trash Talk NYC, spent 100 days cleaning the area around West 171st Street between Broadway and Fort Washington Avenue in Washington Heights, according to Hoodline and Clarke’s own account of the project. Clarke initially set out with little more than trash bags, a grabber and his phone. He documented the cleanups on social media, turning a personal attempt to tackle litter near his home into part of a larger campaign focused on neglected streets across New York City.It started with one blockClarke has described feeling frustrated by the condition of his neighbourhood and unsure what one person could realistically do about it. Instead of waiting for a larger cleanup effort, he began picking up litter himself.The idea soon grew beyond simply removing rubbish. Clarke wanted the transformation to be visible enough that people would feel invested in keeping the area clean. His Trash Talk NYC project eventually expanded to other parts of New York, with residents suggesting locations that needed attention. According to Clarke’s account, the project quickly attracted volunteers and attention from local officials and community members. But the 100-day effort in Washington Heights became particularly personal.From rubbish to flower bedsAs the cleanup continued, Clarke began looking at the neglected tree beds along the sidewalk differently. He sourced plants, added soil and mulch, and began turning the spaces around street trees into small gardens.He also built protective fences around some of the beds. The gardening work cost considerably more than the original cleanup: Clarke has said he spent about $2,000 of his own money on fencing and gardening supplies. Local businesses later contributed plants, lumber and other materials, according to Hoodline. The aim was not simply to make the pavement look better. The gardens gave residents something tangible to care for, and made the consequences of neglect more visible.Clarke’s approach also fits with the broader philosophy behind Trash Talk NYC. On the project’s website, he describes litter collection as only a temporary solution and argues that residents need practical ways to take greater ownership of their neighbourhoods.Then the neighbours began joiningThe most striking change came as the work stopped looking like a one-man project. Neighbours began helping with cleanups and taking an interest in the new gardens. The small fences Clarke built around the tree beds became places where people could sit, while the flowers gave the once-neglected spaces a new purpose.Not everything went smoothly. Some plants were stolen, and Clarke has continued asking supporters to help fund the ongoing work. But the response from residents showed that the project had moved beyond simply collecting trash.The transformation also brought attention to the question of who is responsible for keeping New York’s sidewalks clean. The city’s rules place much of that responsibility on property owners, while community groups and volunteers frequently take on additional cleanup and beautification work.A 100-day challenge that kept goingClarke’s original challenge may have been limited to 100 days, but the project did not stop there. His social-media updates continued after the milestone, while Trash Talk NYC has grown into a wider effort involving volunteers across New York.What began with one person picking up litter on his block has therefore become something more ambitious: an attempt to make residents active participants in the appearance and upkeep of their streets.The lesson from the Washington Heights block is relatively simple. Clarke did not begin with a large organisation, a city grant or a team of workers. He began with a grabber, some bags and the decision to show up every day. By the time the 100 days were over, he was no longer the only person showing up.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: In 2013, Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. paid $6.1 million for their LA home; 13 years later, they have cut the asking price to $9.95 million
articles.summary: News News: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. have reduced the asking price of their longtime Los Angeles family home by $550,000, just three months af.
articles.body: Sarah Michelle Gellar and Freddie Prinze Jr. have reduced the asking price of their longtime Los Angeles family home by $550,000, just three months after putting the property on the market. PEOPLE first reported the price cut, while Realtor.com provided additional details on the sprawling Mandeville Canyon residence. The couple has now lowered the asking price to $9.95 million, down from the $10.5 million price tag attached to the property when it was listed in May. The reduction came on Aug. 24, according to property records cited by PEOPLE. Gellar and Prinze bought the home in 2013 for $6.1 million, meaning the latest asking price is about $3.85 million higher than what they originally paid, before accounting for the cost of ownership, upgrades and other expenses over the years.A six-bedroom family home in Mandeville CanyonThe property is located in Los Angeles’ sought-after Mandeville Canyon and spans roughly 7,300 square feet. PEOPLE describes the residence as having six bedrooms and six bathrooms. The discrepancy appears to stem from differences in how the rooms are classified in the listing materials.Designed in a Hamptons-inspired style, the house combines expansive interiors with extensive outdoor spaces. Among its standout features are a swimming pool, built-in spa, covered patio, outdoor kitchen and barbecue area. Inside, the home has an open-plan kitchen and living area, a formal dining room, multiple fireplaces and a wet bar. The primary suite includes a private sitting area, a large balcony overlooking the backyard, a spacious bathroom and two walk-in closets. The property also includes a gym, additional living spaces and a third-level den that has been used as a family and games area.From family home to $60,000-a-month rentalThe residence was not simply a place the couple owned, it was their family home for more than a decade. Gellar and Prinze, who married in 2002, raised their two children, Charlotte and Rocky, there. The couple briefly offered the property as a rental in March 2025 for $60,000 a month, according to property records cited by Realtor.com. Listing images suggest the family had already moved out by the time the home went up for sale.Their listing agent, Cindy Ambuehl of Christie’s International Real Estate Southern California, has described the house as particularly suited to family life, pointing to its privacy, natural light and practical layout. The couple has not publicly explained why they decided to leave the property. However, Realtor.com reported that Gellar’s social media activity suggested the pair may have already purchased another home.A home that became part of their family storyThe sale comes as Gellar and Prinze mark nearly a quarter-century of marriage. They celebrated their 24th wedding anniversary on Sept. 1, 2026, with Gellar sharing throwback photographs of the couple.Over the years, Gellar has also spoken about what home ownership has meant to her. Having grown up in a New York City apartment building, she previously described buying her first property at 20 as both overwhelming and a major personal milestone.Now, after 13 years in their Brentwood-area home, the couple is looking for a buyer willing to pay nearly $10 million for the next chapter of a property that once served as the backdrop to their family life. The $550,000 reduction may make the listing more tempting, but for now, the Hollywood couple’s longtime home remains on the market at $9.95 million.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? articles.title: SC reiterates call to CBSE to exempt Class VI from its 3-language policy
articles.summary: India News: New Delhi:New Delhi: Supreme Court Wednesday reiterated its request to the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) to consider exempting Class VI .
articles.body: New Delhi:New Delhi: Supreme Court Wednesday reiterated its request to the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) to consider exempting Class VI students from the three-language policy, which mandates them to take up at least two native languages, and said this would give them breathing space this academic session.A bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana told solicitor general Tushar Mehta that CBSE must examine extending the relaxation given up to Class VII to students of Class VI this year.Mehta said that since it has been observed by SC, he, with additional solicitor general Aishwarya Bhati, would call a meeting of CBSE officials along with other officers concerned this week and take a call on this. "We will appraise the court of the decision taken in the next hearing," he said. SC posted the matter for hearing on Sept 17.When the counsel for petitioners referred to Justice Bagchi's earlier observation on how English should be treated - a native or foreign language - Mehta said govt has some issue with the proposition that English is a native language.Justice Bagchi said, "What is logistically less obstructive is the cutoff year for implementation of the three-language policy. Regarding the status of English, it may require full-fledged debate."SC also issued notice to CBSE on a fresh petition filed by the Forum of Minority Schools. articles.title: Austrian woman dies after alleged sexual abuse by husband as prosecutors probe case dubbed Pelicot 2.0 by local media
articles.summary: A 40-year-old Austrian woman has died from what prosecutors say were fatal injuries after her husband allegedly sexually abused her while she was “extremely intoxicated and therefore defenseless.”
articles.body: A 40-year-old Austrian woman has died from what prosecutors say were injuries after her husband allegedly sexually abused her while she was “extremely intoxicated and therefore defenseless.” Authorities are now investigating whether other men may have also sexually abused the woman, potentially in exchange for payment. The woman has not been named. Austrian media have dubbed the case “Pelicot 2.0,” drawing comparisons to the Frenchwoman Gisèle Pelicot, whose former husband Dominique Pelicot drugged her for years and recruited dozens of strangers to rape her while she was unconscious. Prosecutors in the Austrian city of Wels, about 150 miles West of Vienna, said reports in the local press of a so called wider “rape network” cannot yet be confirmed but remain under investigation. The victim was found severely injured and bleeding at her home in Marchtrenk, near Wels in Upper Austria, on June 26, according to prosecutors. Paramedics pronounced her dead at the scene and an autopsy was ordered. The authorities are investigating claims that the woman was sexually abused by both her 51-year-old husband and another 51-year-old man, the prosecutors said. Both men are now in custody, but prosecutors say only the husband has been linked to the act that caused her death. The second man has confessed and is remorseful, according to prosecutors. He is being investigated over two alleged instances of abuse of a defenseless or impaired person. The husband has declined to comment on the allegations. He is being investigated over allegations of abuse of a defenseless or impaired person resulting in death, an offense carrying a potential sentence of 10 to 20 years in prison or life. He could ultimately face a murder charge, depending on what investigators are able to establish about his intent. Prosecutors said no money is believed to have changed hands between the husband and the second man currently in custody. The Wels Public Prosecutor’s Office told CNN the investigation is ongoing and declined to provide further details about the alleged acts, citing respect for the victim and investigative considerations.

articles.title: US court denies Tate brothers’ bid to be released from Miami jail
articles.summary: A judge rules the brothers are a ‘quintessential flight risk’ due to their wealth and frequent international travel.
articles.body:
A United States judge has turned down a request from social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate to be released from jail as they appeal their extradition to the United Kingdom, where they face rape charges.

On Wednesday, US Magistrate Judge Lauren Louis ruled that the brothers constituted a “quintessential flight risk” because of their wealth and frequent international travel and must therefore remain in a Miami jail.

“While [the brothers] may not in fact possess what extravagant holdings they portray themselves as possessing online, the record reflects that they possess an exceptional capacity to flee the jurisdiction,” Louis wrote.

A lawyer for the brothers said they would “continue to defend themselves against the allegations they face and engage with the appropriate legal processes in each jurisdiction”.

Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami, Florida, on July 18 after the UK requested their extradition to face charges of rape, assault and facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation.

The pair, who have citizenship in the US and the UK, have denied all wrongdoing.

Defence lawyers previously argued that the brothers should be released from jail as they contest their extradition, saying their high-profile status makes fleeing the country unrealistic.

The Tates’ legal team also downplayed the brothers’ depictions of extravagant wealth on social media as “theatrical” and “grandiose”.

Prosecutors said in an August 10 court filing that Andrew and Tristan Tate recruited dozens of women to engage in work doing webcam pornography beginning in 2014. They later offered online courses through a venture called “Hustler’s University”.

During a hearing on August 27, the court was shown a video of Andrew saying, “Slap, slap, grab, choke, shut up b****, sex”, in what appeared to be a description of his “pimping” lifestyle.

The Tates have built a massive online profile through what critics say is a promotion of aggressive misogyny.

In addition to facing charges in the UK, the brothers are also defending themselves in a case in Romania, where they were indicted for trafficking minors , among other offences.

Their defence team cited the Romanian case as another reason the brothers needed to be released from jail.

“They are now facing an extraordinary situation in which they are being held thousands of miles from Romania while Romanian proceedings continue, deadlines approach, an additional indictment is said to be imminent and their own Romanian lawyer says he cannot properly prepare,” a statement from their lawyers said.

“No serious person can pretend that this can be reviewed properly through occasional conversations from a federal detention center in another country.”

articles.title: El Nino puts India on high health-risk radar, says WHO
articles.summary: India News: NEW DELHI: With dengue cases rising in several parts of the country, a WHO assessment has flagged India among nations facing high or very high health .
articles.body: NEW DELHI: With dengue cases rising in several parts of the country, a WHO assessment has flagged India among nations facing high or very high health risks as a strengthening El Nino event alters weather patterns across South Asia.El Nino is a periodic warming of surface waters in central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean that can disrupt weather patterns around the world, influencing rainfall and temperatures far beyond the Pacific.WHO's Global Public Health Situation Analysis - El Nino 2026, released on Sept 5, has identified India as being at high or very high risk, with most of South Asia expected to experience drier-than-normal conditions and above-normal heat during Aug-Oct.The warning comes at a time when vector-borne diseases are already rising in parts of the country. In Delhi, 90 dengue cases were reported in Aug, the highest monthly tally this year, taking the total to 311 by Aug 29. Malaria cases also rose from 17 in July to 53 in Aug, taking the year's tally to 119, according to Municipal Corporation of Delhi.The agency does not link current dengue or malaria cases directly to El Nino, but calls it a risk modifier, with impacts depending on local weather, vulnerability and health-system capacity.For India, heat is a key concern, with higher temperatures potentially causing heat exhaustion and heatstroke and worsening cardiovascular, respiratory, kidney and metabolic illnesses.Extreme heat may also affect maternal and newborn outcomes. Other concerns include malnutrition, food insecurity and worsening non-communicable diseases. Changes in rainfall and water availability could affect food production, while heavy rain and flooding can increase the risk of leptospirosis, particularly where sanitation and drainage are poor. WHO has also flagged the India-Nepal and India-Bhutan borders, where displacement could increase the risk of cross-border disease transmission.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.body: NEW DELHI: Govt on Wednesday approved eight railway multi-tracking projects worth Rs 20,804 crore as part of a big push for faster movement of passengers and goods across its high-density networks.PM Narendra Modi said that these projects will “ensure stronger connectivity, faster passenger movement and lower logistics cost”.Announcing the decisions, railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the multi-tracking projects -- doubling and the laying of third and fourth lines -- spanning 14 districts of West Bengal, Jharkhand, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh; and 17 districts of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Telangana will increase the capacity of the eight lines for running passenger and freight trains. articles.title: Wales risks raising 'one of the unhealthiest generations in decades'
articles.summary: The health of children in Wales is shocking and outcomes for young people are worsening, doctors say.
articles.body:
The health of children in Wales is "shocking" and outcomes for young people are worsening or slowing down in many areas, children's doctors have said.

The Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health (RCPCH) in Wales said without urgent action Wales risked "raising one of the unhealthiest generations of children in decades".

It said the effect was most sharply felt in deprived areas.

The Welsh government said it would consider the finding's "carefully", and that it wanted to deliver a "sustained national focus on babies, children, and young people's health".

The warning is based on an analysis of 12 key indicators including infant mortality, mental health, obesity, vaccine rates and asthma.

It showed vaccination coverage had fallen below recommended levels, with very few routine childhood vaccines now meeting the 95% uptake target.

More than a quarter (27%) of children aged five to six in Wales had obvious tooth decay in 2024-25. Children living in the most deprived areas were nearly twice as likely to have tooth decay as those living in the least.

In 2024-25, 27.3% of children aged four to five were overweight or living with obesity. This is the highest prevalence recorded in Wales to date and the highest rate among all four UK nations.

In addition, an estimated 135,000 children and young people in Wales are living with a diagnosable mental health condition, including one in four 17 to 24-year-olds.

Asthma-related hospital admissions among children aged five to 14 increased sharply in September 2024, with 110 admissions compared with 23 in August – a 378% increase.

RCPCH co-officer for Wales Dr Dana Beasley said the report exposed the "shocking state" of child health in Wales and "the deepening inequalities experienced by families across Wales".

"Behind every statistic is a child whose health, wellbeing and opportunities in life can be affected for years to come," she said.

"We cannot accept a situation where a child's chances of growing up healthy are so heavily influenced by where they live or the circumstances, they are born into."

Is the Welsh government doing enough to support child health?

The report highlighted a significant amount of concern among parents about the state of services.

It commissioned a recent YouGov poll which suggested less than a third (27%) of respondents felt the Welsh government was doing enough to support child health.

It found 18% of respondents believed the Welsh government's NHS spending on child health was "about right".

About two-thirds (68%) of respondents believed the cost-of-living crisis is having a negative impact on child health.

The college has called on the Plaid Cymru government to honour its manifesto commitment to develop a Children's Health Plan.

It argued the plan should focus on three key priorities - revolving around data, targets and investment.

RCPCH co-officer for Wales Dr Lizzy Nickerson said: "Wales urgently needs a clear and ambitious Children's Health Plan that puts prevention, early intervention and reducing inequalities at its heart.

"This must be evidence-based, data-driven and shaped by the expertise of clinicians alongside the voices and experiences of children and young people themselves.

"We need stronger, more transparent child health data, meaningful targets that allow progress to be measured, and a clear focus on closing the gap between children living in the most and least advantaged communities.

"Children's health cannot be an afterthought – it must be a long-term priority for the Welsh government.

Wales' children's commissioner, Rocio Cifuentes, said: "Children have the right to the highest attainable standard of health, yet this report shows that too many children in Wales are being let down by widening inequalities and inconsistent access to support.

"The findings echo what children and young people have consistently told me - that support often comes too late, that access to services such as mental health and dental care can be difficult, and that healthy choices are not always the easiest choices."

A Welsh government spokesperson said it had a "comprehensive range of policies and programmes" which played a "crucial role" in improving health outcomes for children in Wales, with early years development, vaccination, and mental health support "central to our approach".

"We know the early years of a child's life are crucial, not only for their development but also for shaping their future health, wellbeing and life chances," they said.

"We are considering options to provide a stronger and more sustained national focus on babies, children and young people's health, ensuring prevention, early intervention and integrated service delivery remain at the forefront of policy and service development in Wales."

articles.title: Jet plunges 27,000 feet in 10 minutes as oxygen masks suddenly drop aboard flight
articles.summary: Delta Air Lines Flight 2311 experienced a scary emergency when the plane descended roughly 27,000 feet in about 10 minutes because of a pressurization issue.
articles.body: Travelers aboard a recent Delta Air Lines flight faced a midair scare when oxygen masks suddenly dropped in the passenger cabin. A pressurization issue occurred aboard Delta Flight 2311 on Sept. 6, prompting the crew to bring the plane to a lower altitude and divert to Las Vegas, a Delta spokesperson told Fox News Digital. The flight was carrying 174 passengers and six crew members. 'WE NEED TO RETURN IMMEDIATELY,' FLIGHT CREW WARNS AS PILOT HEALTH EMERGENCY UNFOLDS "As safety comes before everything else at Delta, the flight crew of Delta flight 2311 LAX-SLC followed their training and procedures to safely bring the aircraft to optimal altitude when an unexpected pressurization issue occurred," the spokesperson said. The flight, which was traveling from Los Angeles to Salt Lake City, descended roughly 27,000 feet in about 10 minutes as oxygen masks deployed in the cabin, according to reports. News of the rapid descent could be heard in communications between the pilots and air traffic control. "Delta 2311 currently [in] rapid descent. We'd like to get down to 9,000, and we're direct [to] Las Vegas," a pilot said in an air traffic control recording, according to reports. When an air traffic controller asked, "Is the oxygen deployed?" the pilot responded, "Affirmative." CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER The aircraft landed safely at Harry Reid International Airport in Vegas, where passengers exited normally, according to Delta. Delta arranged for another aircraft so that passengers could continue on with their journey. "Delta sincerely apologizes to our customers for their experience and thanks our flight crews and other support teams on the ground for their professionalism," the spokesperson said. Matthew "Whiz" Buckley of Florida, a retired U.S. Navy F/A-18 fighter pilot with nearly 40 years of flying experience, said such a pressurization occurrence "is an extremely rare issue" in the United States. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE STORIES In a case such as the Delta one, he told Fox News Digital pilots in this scenario would need "to land as soon as practical — meaning, what's the closest airfield with a nice, long, suitable runway where we can get this thing on the ground safely." The incident drew attention online. A passenger aboard the flight talked about the chaos inside the cabin. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ "The scariest part wasn't even the descent — it was not knowing what was going on," the passenger wrote on Reddit. "Flight attendants were trying to make announcements with their masks on, and it was almost impossible to hear them." The passenger was reportedly asleep when a fiancé said something about what was going on. "It took me another second of 'Is this real or am I dreaming?' before getting our masks on," the traveler wrote. "I was frantically trying to see if I could get on WiFi because I didn't know if I was going to have to be sending out 'I love you' texts," the person added. "It took me another second of 'Is this real or am I dreaming?' before getting our masks on." Other travelers responded to the post by sharing their own experiences with oxygen masks and rapid descents. One Reddit user recalled a previous Delta flight that descended from about 34,000 feet to 10,000 feet while passengers wore oxygen masks. [were] pretty jarring until the captain finally came on the mic once we were at a safe altitude," the commenter wrote, adding that passengers remained quiet and focused on breathing through their masks.

articles.title: Pay Rs 15L to 'outstanding' officer shunted out as 'deadwood': Supreme Court
articles.summary: India News: NEW DELHI: Taking exception to Centre declaring an \"outstanding\" Indian Trade Service officer \"dead wood\" and punishing him with compulsory retirement.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Taking exception to Centre declaring an "outstanding" Indian Trade Service officer "dead wood" and punishing him with compulsory retirement, Supreme Court Wednesday directed all pecuniary benefits and notional promotions to him be restored and ordered govt to pay him Rs 15 lakh as compensation. S S Das was forced to retire in 2018, five years before his superannuation.A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu, which had directed Centre to place dossiers and the annual confidential record of the officer before it, found he was consistently graded as outstanding/very good from 1994 and promoted just months before the punishment. It directed govt to grant Das the honourable farewell he would have been entitled to had he not been forced to retire."The manner of decision-making in course whereof 'OUTSTANDING' gradings are completely ignored, grant of promotion is looked upon as if it were a ministerial exercise, followed by a vague and omnibus finding that it is not desirable in public interest to retain the appellant in service, discloses that the officers entrusted to take a decision were determined to ensure the appellant's ouster at any cost and invented reasons to sustain a pre-decided conclusion," the bench said, calling the exercise "sheer abuse of high offices"."Having promoted the appellant, barely a couple of months later, the superior officers in the department could not have branded him... 'dead wood' to justify weeding him out. The two actions are mutually destructive and cannot co-exist," it said.SC said the action demolished the reputation of an officer which was uncalled for. It directed that Das be called to the office by the director general of foreign trade for a farewell with full honours."It must be remembered by all and sundry that reputation is not built overnight. It is built by years of dedicated and selfless service. It comes at a great cost, often at the cost of family life and personal comfort. Such a reputation earned by sweat and toil over decades can, however, be marred by a single stroke of a pen," the bench said.SC said FR 56(j) - which gives Centre the right to prematurely retire a govt servant - should not be exercised lightly or in a casual manner. articles.body: NEW DELHI: PM Narendra Modi will host a gala dinner for the leaders participating in the Brics summit on Saturday evening, said govt in an announcement Wednesday. The summit will formally begin earlier in the day with Modi welcoming the leaders of Brics member states at the venue, Bharat Mandapam, and later joining them for a closed session titled Inclusive Global Governance and Strengthening Multilateralism.India is hosting the 18th Brics summit on Sept 12-13, exactly 20 years after the grouping that counts 11 major emerging economies as members was formalised. After the session, the leaders will witness the Bharat Innovates exhibition at the summit venue, before congregating on the outside lawns for a Brics family photo. This event will be followed by leaders participating in a joint tree plantation.Modi is also expected to have a formal bilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping Saturday in which both leaders will look to consolidate gains from the recent uptick in bilateral ties. Xi had last visited India in 2019 for the Mammalapuram informal summit. A formal announcement by Beijing about Xi's visit was still awaited on Wednesday.Modi's bilateral meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin is scheduled for Friday. The PM is also expected to have a meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. UAE will likely be represented by Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Bridging bilateral divides over the West Asia situation to secure a unified Brics declaration remains the primary hurdle for India, ahead of the meetings.On Sunday - second day of summit - Modi will welcome leaders of the 10 Brics partner countries, along with other outreach invitees. The leaders will join the final session titled Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability: Shaping the Future for Inclusive Global Growth.The summit will see a renewed call by Modi for a reinvigorated, inclusive and effective multilateral order at a time when the world is faced with complex challenges. articles.title: Gavin Newsom expresses 'openness' to packing SCOTUS, calls Electoral College system 'perverted'
articles.summary: Dem California Gov. Gavin Newsom said he was "evolving" on the idea of expanding the Supreme Court and eliminating the Electoral College during an interview Tuesday.
articles.body: California Gov. Gavin Newsom expressed "openness" to reforming the Supreme Court and claimed the Electoral College "perverted" politics during an interview with former CNN host Don Lemon on his podcast Tuesday. Near the end of the interview, Lemon directly asked Newsom, a rumored 2028 candidate, whether he believed the judicial branch needed to be expanded, an idea pushed by several Democratic figures, including former Vice President Kamala Harris. "My initial instinct — me, a year ago, I would have said no out of concern that it will continue to be expanded," Newsom said. "And I was making a case for the ethical reforms and term limits, 18 years, which I was making a case a year ago. I'm more open to it on the basis of those district court arguments, which are not terrible arguments." DEMOCRATIC SENATOR CLAIMS GOP 'STOLE' TWO SCOTUS SEATS IN 2016, 2020, CALLS FOR EXPANSION "Is that a yes?" Lemon asked. "I'm finding myself evolving on it. I normally have very clear conviction on things. I've been open to argument and interested in the evidence on this," Newsom answered. He described his position as "caution on expanding it, but openness," adding that he believes reforms like term limits are a "no-brainer." HARRIS LABELED 'INSTITUTIONAL ARSONIST' FOR PLAN TO FUNDAMENTALLY TRANSFORM SCOTUS AND ELECTORAL COLLEGE The California Democrat had harsher criticism of the Electoral College, suggesting that it has "perverted" U.S. politics. "California has already been a leader that's already gone out front saying it's time to change that system. Which state's more burdened by it than my state? We're the size of 21 state populations combined. Come on. And we have two representatives in the Senate? Come on. "And the way that thing favors ... it's perverted, I think, our politics. The Constitution is a living document, and it was conceived to be amended, and I think it's time to make that amendment," Newsom said. Fox News Digital reached out to Newsom's office for comment. CARVILLE TELLS DEMS TO QUIETLY PREPARE POWER GRAB WITH DC, PUERTO RICO STATEHOOD AND SUPREME COURT PACKING Though Newsom has not explicitly supported expanding the Supreme Court, he made similar comments suggesting an openness to it during an interview with Brian Tyler Cohen on his podcast in June. Cohen was arguing in favor of court expansion, and Newsom remarked that Cohen was "getting me closer to your point of view." During an interview with "PBS NewsHour" on Monday, Newsom also said the Democratic Party is "pretty aligned" with the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) on issues like universal healthcare, climate change and moving off fossil fuels. The DSA's goals include eliminating the Supreme Court and replacing it with a judiciary that would be selected by Congress. House Democrats recently voted against a constitutional amendment to cap the number of justices on the Supreme Court at nine. Rep. Andy Biggs, R-Ariz., who introduced the measure, warned Congress about the downsides of expanding the court.
